Goa on our minds Here’s a big hello from Rene & Vaibhav who love themselves a strong coffee but also a long nap. We started out as writers / journalists but one of us (guess who!) developed an all-consuming love for funky printed shirts. payload.text_excerpt: Bengaluru’s best boutiques | Condé Nast Traveller India Skip to main content Open Navigation Menu Bengaluru’s best boutiques More Search The Latest Destinations Hotels & Homestays Food & Drink People & Culture BLACK BOOK Readers' Travel Awards Mindful Travel Video CNT TOP RESTAURANT AWARDS People & Culture Bengaluru’s best boutiques From Diane von Fürstenberg and Prada to Jason Cherian and Rohit Bal, Bengaluru stocks and shelves it all By Neville Bhandara 7 June 2011 The Collective From Diane von Fürstenberg and Prada to Jason Cherian and Rohit Bal, Bengaluru stocks and shelves it all. Here are Condé Nast Traveller's selections of five favourite boutiques that promise pure shopping bliss: The Collective The Collective knows that shopping isn't just a girly pastime. Here you'll find the best of Indian and Western design for both women and men, enough to spoil anyone silly. Diane von Furstenberg, Juicy Couture and Prada hold court alongside famed Indian designers Rohit Bal, Rajesh Pratap Singh and Tarun Tahiliani. The Collective, 40, Vittal Mallya Road, Bengaluru (+91 80 6767 8888; www.thecollective.in ) RainTree Housed in a handsome 75-year old colonial bungalow, RainTree is a favourite stop for the fashion-forward. Collections from seasoned designers like Ritu Kumar and Wendell Rodricks are featured here alongside new entrants like Jason Cherian. RainTree also stocks a range of beautiful furniture, jewellery and beauty products by Ally Matthan. Recharge after a shopping spree

Anavila Anavila, Khar, Mumbai See On Map VISIT SITE This label was launched in 2011 and has maintained versatility in its essence since then. They believe in recycling and upcycling, and their products are made from leftover textiles, or by upcycling the waste that can be utilised in textures. Visit to get your hands on organic textiles that are trendy, comfortable, and perfect for that occasion you’ve been planning an outfit for. #LBBTip - we hear the saris at this store are a big hit with the celebrities. Nicobar Nicobar, Fort, Mumbai See On Map VISIT SITE Since summer is in full swing, their dresses and tunics are going to be our go-to outfits when it comes to meetings and those fancy work parties. Collections from seasoned designers like Ritu Kumar and Wendell Rodricks are featured here alongside new entrants like Jason Cherian. RainTree also stocks a range of beautiful furniture, jewellery and beauty products by Ally Matthan. Recharge after a shopping spree
